name: zcode-plugin
description: Personal ZCode plugin collection: git-workflow (conventional commits), dev-workflow (development flow skills) and guardrails (safety hooks).

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Conventional commit workflow: /gcommit generates spec-compliant commit messages, /gpr writes PR descriptions, /gchangelog builds changelogs; a PostToolUse hook checks the message after each commit.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Daily development workflow: 7 flow skills (change-plan, debug, test-changed, review, commit-review, release-check, doc-gen), /handoff contract persistence, a SessionStart repo snapshot, and 16 specialist subagents auto-installed into ~/.zcode/agents.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic safety hooks: blocks irreversible shell commands and hardcoded credentials, routes publishing, deploys and migrations to a confirmation prompt.
